sections.title: Confirm the next visiting date before paying for a session
sections.html:
A colour-analysis search for Kingston can lead to a travelling consultant or a past event. The listing is useful as a provider lead, but it does not establish that a local appointment is available today. Check the next visit before arranging your schedule or paying a deposit.

French Touch of Colour

The provider’s schedule showed Kingston visits on October 22–23, 2026, which had already passed when this guide was checked on October 30. Its menu lists an Essential service at C$210 for about an hour and a Complete service at C$275 for 90 minutes, with additional makeup review and follow-up. Ask about the next Kingston date.

sections.title: Separate package selection from date confirmation
sections.html:
Ask whether a future Kingston session is confirmed, where it will take place and which packages will be offered. If makeup is your main concern, compare the basic colour work with the more detailed makeup review rather than choosing on duration alone. Keep a written record of the appointment date, cancellation terms and what happens if the visiting event changes.

  • When is the next confirmed Kingston appointment date?
  • Does my chosen package include makeup review and follow-up?

sections.title: Make the waiting time useful without buying a new wardrobe
sections.html: While waiting for availability, explore one palette and two outfit combinations at home. The app can help you build a short list of questions for a later consultation. Bring examples of what still feels uncertain, such as a difficult neutral or two similar lip colours. That makes the eventual appointment more useful than repeating a broad request to be told your season.

sections.title: What you can explore while a local date is unconfirmed
sections.html:
The extra C$65 between the listed packages buys a different described scope, not a guarantee that either one is available in Kingston on your preferred date. Request the booking terms for that visit, including what happens if the event is postponed and how follow-up is provided after the consultant leaves.

Stylist AI can be used independently while you wait. The introduction starts with a selfie, then lets you explore seasonal colours, outfit combinations, hair ideas and makeup previews. Its garment comparison can help you consider a specific clothing colour. Choose a visiting consultation if you want a person to explain physical drapes; use the app for ongoing self-guided exploration without depending on an event schedule.

editorial.leadHtml:
A past event is a provider lead

It is not proof of a currently bookable Kingston session. Ask for the next confirmed visit and venue before arranging travel or paying a deposit.

Essential: C$210, about one hour.

Complete: C$275, about 90 minutes, with additional makeup review and follow-up described.
